about: Combination-sentence test vectors for every multi-select question (multi, pictureChoice). The server (MultiNarration) and the filler / Studio preview (TypeScript mirror) must give exactly these words. Each case: a field (v2 definition, says.combinations), the answers, the words the field writes (as the case note's only template '{{key}}'), and the id of the combination that fires (null = none, the plain loop). Rules are tried top to bottom and the FIRST that fits wins: exact = the picked set equals the rule's options; includes = every option of the rule is picked. {others} = the other picks' own sentences (the rule's text without {others}: the others follow it with the field's normal joiner; with nothing else picked the {others} and the clause before it up to the last comma, semicolon or linking word are dropped). Option keys match in any case. Narrate with the field alone on one page with the section template '{{key}}'. pictureChoice only: config.total {label, unit?, decimals?} with each option's value: after the picked words (and before negative history) the sentence '{label} {sum}{unit}' is added, sum of the PICKED options' value (missing = 0), rounded half away from zero to decimals (default 0, dot), the unit set against the number when it starts with % or a degree sign, otherwise after a space; nothing picked = no total.
